statement: The planar Mumford–Shah regularity conjecture and local weak-L4 gradient bounds. Resolves the interior regularity conjecture for reduced absolute planar Mumford–Shah minimizers with bounded fidelity data. Locally, the closed discontinuity set is a $`C^{1,\alpha}`$ arc, a regular crack tip, or three arcs meeting at $`120^\circ`$; only finitely many global connected components meet any compact interior region.
